piece: Mixed flat and smooth f32 reads
sentences: A pixel shader may use `v_interp_mov_f32 p0` and `v_interp_p1/p2_f32` on the same input location.
The translator declares it `PerVertexKHR`, takes vertex 0 for the MOV, and interpolates the smooth read with the triangle weights.
The fallback modes without per-vertex inputs reject this combination.

The synthetic `mixed_f32_varying.asm` fixture and CPU interpreter check both reads at two points of one triangle. [AMD RDNA 2 ISA, VINTRP instructions](https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/radeon-tech-docs/instruction-set-architectures/rdna2-shader-instruction-set-architecture.pdf)
